_comment: Every finding the engine emits must carry a clause ID from this file, or it is not a finding — it is an opinion, and it belongs in the unresolved bucket. Clause text is quoted verbatim in the UI and in the reconsideration letter, never paraphrased.

AME.EXCL.PHARMA.text: Cost of pharmacy and consumables may not be part of the definition of associate medical expenses.

AME.EXCL.IMPLANT.text: Cost of implants and medical devices may not be part of the definition of associate medical expenses.

AME.EXCL.DIAG.text: Cost of diagnostics may not be part of the definition of associate medical expenses.

PD.LIMIT.text: Insurers shall not recover any expenses towards proportionate deductions other than the defined associate medical expenses.

PD.ICU.text: Proportionate deduction may not be applied in respect of ICU charges, as ICU categories do not exist.

PD.DIFFBILL.text: Proportionate deduction may not be applied in respect of hospitals which do not follow differential billing based on room category.

PD.NOCLAUSE.text: This policy wording contains no proportionate-deduction clause, so no proportionate deduction can be applied under it.

TAT.PREAUTH.source: Master Circular on Health Insurance Business
TAT.PREAUTH.text: The insurer shall decide on a cashless pre-authorisation request within one hour of receipt.

TAT.DISCHARGE.source: Master Circular on Health Insurance Business
TAT.DISCHARGE.text: The insurer shall grant final authorisation for discharge within three hours of the request from the hospital.

TAT.NOWAIT.source: Master Circular on Health Insurance Business
TAT.NOWAIT.text: In no case shall the policyholder be made to wait to be discharged. Where there is a delay beyond three hours, the additional amount charged by the hospital shall be borne by the insurer from the shareholder's fund.

LIMIT.ROOM.text: Room rent is payable up to the per-day limit stated in the policy schedule.

LIMIT.AMBULANCE.text: Ambulance charges are payable up to the per-claim limit stated in the policy schedule.

LIMIT.ICU.text: ICU charges are payable up to the per-day limit stated in the policy schedule.

COPAY.PCT.text: The policyholder shall bear the co-payment percentage stated in the policy schedule on each admissible claim.

DEDUCT.AMT.text: The deductible stated in the policy schedule shall be borne by the policyholder before the insurer's liability begins.

SI.EXHAUSTED.text: The insurer's liability in aggregate shall not exceed the sum insured stated in the policy schedule.

NP.ITEM.ANNEXURE_II.source: Master Circular on Health Insurance Business
NP.ITEM.ANNEXURE_II.text: Items listed as non-payable are not admissible unless a rider or endorsement on this policy expressly covers them.

NP.RIDER.COVERED.text: An endorsement on this policy expressly covers this item, so the non-payable list does not apply to it.

ADM.NOTINFORCE.text: Cover is available only for an admission occurring within the policy period stated in the schedule.

ADM.WAITING.INITIAL.text: Claims arising within the initial waiting period stated in the schedule are not admissible, other than for accidental injury.
